title: SEVEN ACTIVISTS LIBERATE 16 BROILER CHICKENS.
content:
15th October, Argentina.







via: @anarcoveganismo.arg




ENGLISH (translated):




“For politicians, the justice system and those who profit from animal life, there is a difference between an animal being killed in a slaughterhouse to sell its body and generate capital, or starving to death on farms — this represents a loss of invested capital.⁠

⁠

For us, every individual life has value, so we only have one chance, and we won’t waste it waiting for the justice system to decide. Nor shall we waste her begging for mercy and for her murderers to give us a life.⁠

⁠

And there we are, in broad daylight, in full view of some curious onlookers, cutting through the plastic to give them freedom, the freedom they have been denied since the moment they were born.⁠

⁠




We only care about each other so they can be free, because they only have us by their side to break the cage.⁠”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: ANONYMOUS GROUP LIBERATES 100 HENS FROM A BARN
content:
October, France.




received anonymously via email:







“We believe that the structures of speciesism are vulnerable and accessible.




Last week, we – an anonymous group – went to a factory farm in France and helped 100 hens escape from it. A few hours later, the liberated hens were already running on the grass and petting each other.




Rage consumed us when we arrived at the barn. The sky was dark, and everything was silent except for their screams and talks inside.




We entered and took them out, as fast as we could. After that, the night didn’t have the same color. We could hear them talk in their transport cages but we knew that they were free from harm, at last.







And, of course, we still deeply think of the ones who are still inside. We will continue to fight so that, one day, everyone could be free and safe.




If you can, please go inside those places of oppression, open the cages and take them out. You will experience more rage, fear and hope that what you are probably used to but every second of it will be so worth it. Because when you go on with your daily life later, you will know that the people you helped escape are now free and safe.







Thank you to everyone who fight alongside other animals and good luck with your actions.”

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: TWO HENS LIBERATED FROM A BARN.
content:
Summer, Utah USA.







received anonymously via email:




“On a hot summer morning at a Utah cage free farm, after some surveillance, we were able to identify entrances into the massive death prisons, but quickly realized numerous humans were nearby and entering our building of choice. We pivoted and moved to the furthest shed away and quickly entered. Upon entering, we found hundreds of chickens crammed together, some of them dead stuck underneath metal beams.




When grabbing these chickens, we expected to be met with fear and resistance. Instead we met 2 gentle birds who had seemingly given up on their lives, knowing nothing but suffering and pain. We like to imagine they both willingly got into my arms, knowing we were there to help bring them into a better world, but we think its far more likely that they felt they had nothing to struggle or fight for. They were docile and quiet towards us while being transported despite knowing nothing from humans but cruelty.




We say to those watching and listening, are you not horrified when you see the countless images of animal cruelty? Does your heart, when faced with the images of their torment, not also feel total repulsion and an obligation to act? Now is the time. All you need is an address, a vehicle, and the will to act.
